job.title: Junior Frontend Developer (React)
job.description: TechSprint Labs is an agile SaaS product studio in Hyderabad. We are looking for a Junior Frontend Developer to build clean, responsive dashboards and web interfaces. Core requirements: solid TypeScript, React 18, HTML5/CSS3, and state management (Zustand or Redux Toolkit). Experience writing component tests with Vitest or Jest is highly preferred.
